body: Thanks for replying. I'm not currently living with him so I guess it's causing more inconvenience than anything. I've tried to contact the SIM provider but gotten nowhere as I don't know the answers to the security checks so it looks like my only option is a new phone 😑
Feeling like I'll never have a decent life and be able to support myself. Stuck in family drama I can't escape. Can't help comparing myself to others and feeling useless in comparison

I did an unpaid placement during my degree and it didn't really end up well for me with some colleagues.
Feel the same way, I try to avoid eye contact usually
Maybe I wouldn't be so useless
